parameters.content:
Supabase job trigger (alternate entry point)

Configure a Supabase Database Webhook on public.ai_jobs INSERT. Send the inserted row to this n8n webhook when job_type = parse_document and status = queued.

This entry point uses the same fenced claim as the polling workflow: rpc/claim_document_job mints the attempt claim token; publication/failure go through rpc/complete_document_job and rpc/fail_document_job_attempt. The webhook cannot bypass lease, capacity, or ownership rules.

Worker response contract

The worker downloads the document itself from canonical Storage state, parses it, runs grouped extraction/AI, persists checkpoint tables, and returns JSON: facts[], summary, summary_sources[], health_snapshots[], alerts[], actions[], anomalies[], processing_status.

The worker only computes checkpoints; final results are published once by rpc/complete_document_job, which validates the claim token and lease inside the publication transaction.

parameters.content:
Required n8n environment variables

SUPABASE_URL
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
XASS_DOCUMENT_WORKER_URL
XASS_WORKER_SECRET
XASS_N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET (optional)

Never expose the service-role key in the Next.js app.

Cutover: import while inactive, apply migration 202611020002, then activate either this webhook workflow or the polling workflow — not both uncontrolled. Old executions calling the dropped unfenced claim RPCs fail loudly instead of bypassing fencing.
